title: Rate Limiting in ASP.NET Core
description: Implement rate limiting to protect APIs from abuse.

data.text: Rate limiting restricts how many requests a client can make in a given time window. ASP.NET Core 7+ includes built-in rate limiting middleware.
Use a fixed window limiter for simple per-IP restrictions.
When the limit is exceeded, ASP.NET Core returns 429 Too Many Requests. You can customize the response.

data.title: Partitioned Limiter
data.text: Use AddPartitionedLimiter to apply different limits per user, API key, or region.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Rate limiting prevents abuse and DoS
Fixed window is simple and effective
Partition limits by user or key for fairness
data.takeaway: Next, we'll secure APIs further with API keys.
